measuredOn: Google Pixel 10a, API 37, fingerprint google/stallion/stallion:17/CP2A.260805.005/2026081301:user/release-keys. Every baseline here is from one real-device run on 2026-08-27, re-recorded wholesale against the redesign and a full fixture rebuild rather than mixing old and new numbers. The device sat idle and cooling for 15 minutes before this run (battery temperature 26.3C at the start of the wait, 25.9C at the end, screen off throughout) - the rested-device methodology this recording follows, folded in as part of its own scope. Every one of the 31 pre-existing measurements moved by -33% to +24% against the 2026-08-19 recording, consistent, mixed-direction and explainable by fixture growth and ordinary device noise - none of the broad, mostly one-directional +5%-to-+360% drift a warm device previously showed reproduced here, which answers that question by construction. targetMs for the 9 new measurements is picked by analogy to an existing measurement's own device-observed cost, not derived from the web probe's targets, the same reasoning given for the original five. budgetMs is max(200, baselineMs x 5) throughout (budgets.mjs's own rule), so a fast measurement's budget is the 200ms floor rather than a literal 5x - most of the new measurements land there. Nine entries were added on 2026-09-24 for ux-carpet ticket 204, after measure.ts had gained them without an Android budget - search-everywhere, hub-last-writes, words-filter-change and the six mount-* entries - from one run on this same Pixel, rested first by the same method: 15 minutes screen off, battery 30.2C at the start of the wait and 24.9C at the end. Only those nine were taken from that run; every other baseline above is still the 2026-08-27 recording, and that run's numbers for them all passed their budgets. Several have fallen far below their 2026-08-27 baseline since (stock-projection 31ms against 632, tryout-detail-entries 82 against 3634, daylio-import 3328 against 12299), which is later work landing rather than noise, and the largest rise was photo-grid-list at 142ms against 96. Re-recording all of them wholesale is its own decision; this entry adds the missing nine and changes nothing else. Their budgets follow the same max(200, baselineMs x 5) rule, and the mounts' count budgets follow mountBudgetsFor() (statements exact, bytes +10%). Their targetMs is carried across from tests/long-journal/budgets.json rather than set to the budget as the logged block does, since a target is a judgement about a person waiting rather than a measurement. Two of them land over their target on this device: search-everywhere at 313ms against 150ms, and mount-care at 563ms against 250ms; budgets.mjs treats that as a release problem with a ticket of its own, not something to widen here. mount-care was re-recorded on this same Pixel on 2026-09-24 for ux-carpet ticket 221, from one run rested the same way (15 minutes screen off, battery 25.9C at the end of the wait): readCare now reads the 90-day totals window of the dose log rather than all of it, and the mount went from 563ms / 15 statements / 610603 bytes to 63ms / 15 / 30109, inside its 250ms target. Only that entry was taken from this run. search-everywhere was re-recorded on this same Pixel on 2026-09-24 for ux-carpet ticket 220, from one rested run of the same kind with that ticket merged: the search is now one statement of about 10KB rather than two of about 123KB each, each spelling the 86-step letter fold once per column, and it went from 313ms to 116ms, inside its 150ms target. Only that entry was taken from that run.
fixture: seed 1, 3653 days ending epoch day 20676: 3291 entries over 2634 days with entries, 422 photos (394MB on disk), 125 lab results, 12 milestones, 24 tags. 265 entries carry a body-region euphoria or dysphoria value. Three regimen episodes: oral Estradiol from day 30 (Monday/Wednesday/Friday, two-amount schedule, 1475 dose events, 95% of expected slots), Spironolactone for ~500 days in the middle (daily, ends well before the fixture's last 90 days), and injectable Estradiol valerate for the final 150 days (weekly, im) - the last two overlap the first, so a stretch of the fixture has two concurrently active episodes. 19 hair-progress stagings and 5 dated photos. A year each (irregular cadence, ending at the fixture's last day) of measurements, size records, hair-removal sessions, wear sessions and cycle events; a handful of side effects, personal effects, roadmap checks, letters, tryouts and one surgical procedure across the whole decade; ~16 voice recordings; one drug's stock count recorded years ago (so its projection reads the whole dose log) and one recorded near the end (so it doesn't). Encryption on: SQLCipher under the Android Keystore data key, photos through app-private file storage.
